comparison.objective: Place three items into a moving carton; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception and placement into a moving receptacle versus recessed tool engagement, counterholding, fine rotation, locking, and iterative response assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Three items must enter the passing carton; candidate requires quantified repeated stopping behavior and setting retention. Setup and scoring fields are missing.
comparison.reason: Moving-target packing does not test adjustment or force-limited locking of a mechanical control.
